name: app-shell
description: Application frame with a sectioned sidebar, sticky header and scrolling main; the sidebar becomes a left Drawer on small screens.
designIntent: Every dashboard hand-rolls the same shell: rail, header, scroll owner, and a mobile nav. AppShell owns the structure and responsive switch while staying presentational — you pass the active route and a router link component, so it works with React Router, Next Link, or plain anchors.

props.name: sidebar
props.description: Desktop rail content; also rendered inside the mobile drawer (AppShell).

props.name: hideMobileMenu
props.description: Hide the built-in burger button when the header owns navigation (AppShell).

props.name: sidebarWidth
props.description: Tailwind width class for the desktop rail (AppShell).

props.name: heading
props.description: Brand/mark at the top of the rail (Sidebar).

props.name: activeHref
props.description: Current route; matching items get aria-current=page (Sidebar).

props.name: linkComponent
props.description: Router link component (react-router Link, Next Link) (Sidebar).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the nav landmark (Sidebar).

props.name: children
props.description: Nested items — renders a collapsible group with aria-expanded (SidebarItem).

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: SidebarItem hrefs of groups open initially (Sidebar).

props.name: mobileBreakpoint
props.description: Breakpoint where the rail becomes a drawer (AppShell).

props.name: openNavigationLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the mobile menu button.

props.name: navigationTitle
props.description: Title of the mobile navigation drawer.

examples.title: Dashboard shell
examples.description: Router-agnostic: pass your Link component and the current path.

examples.title: Header only
examples.description: Skip the sidebar when the product is a single surface.

antiPatterns.title: Don't nest scroll containers
antiPatterns.explanation: AppShell's main is the scroll owner. Adding h-screen/overflow-hidden wrappers inside breaks sticky headers and mobile drawer focus.

antiPatterns.title: Don't hardcode anchors for SPA routes
antiPatterns.explanation: Plain <a href> triggers full page loads in client-side routers. Pass your router's Link via linkComponent.

accessibility.implementation: Sidebar renders nav with an accessible name (label prop)
accessibility.userRequirements: Keep one primary nav per page; use other labels for secondary rails
Pass activeHref (or item.active) so the state is announced

accessibility.implementation: The rail becomes a Drawer with focus trap, Escape, focus restore and a labelled dialog
accessibility.userRequirements: Don't duplicate the nav in two places at once

guidelines: Group by workflow, not by component type

compositionRules.relationship: AppShell mounts the mobile navigation Drawer for you when a sidebar is provided
Header actions live in the header slot
